description: Assistant text with a tool call written as text. `input` is what the model wrote; `expected` is what stays visible and saved. Read by tests/unit/agentic/test_text_sanitize.py (sanitize_assistant_text) and by frontend/src/features/conversations/__tests__/textToolLeakParity.test.ts (residualToolBlocks.ts): both must agree. The frontend compares only the markdown it renders, with whitespace collapsed.
